subject.title: fix: local gateway connections recover after listener or token drift

question: Should upgrades from settings files that predate `EnableManagedLocalGatewayAutoRepair` automatically enroll existing setup-managed local gateways in WSL restart and proven-native-process remediation, or should that behavior remain disabled until explicitly enabled?
rationale: Both choices are technically supportable, but this changes the recovery contract for existing users and cannot be resolved from implementation tests or contributor comments alone.

options.title: Preserve existing-install behavior
options.body: Migrate pre-field settings to disabled while retaining default-on repair for fresh setup, then add upgrade coverage for the migration.

options.title: Approve automatic enrollment
options.body: Explicitly accept default-on recovery for existing recognized gateways and record the upgrade behavior as a maintainer-approved compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing-install behavior
recommendation.body: Migrate pre-field settings to disabled while retaining default-on repair for fresh setup, then add upgrade coverage for the migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the policy documentation and compatibility tests and can route the decision to the appropriate connection-area owner; no stronger current-main owner was established in the available evidence.
